purpose: Find publicly available AC1024 DWGs that could reproduce the AutoCAD 2010 RTM CLASSES string-size high-bit failure without overstating producer provenance.
finding: The LibreDWG 2010-labelled corpus and historical Autodesk AutoCAD sample collection were downloaded to scratch storage and screened. All 28 AC1024 candidates reached readDwgClasses END with no CLASSES CRC mismatch. No exact AutoCAD 2010 RTM-produced failing DWG was found; per-file producer-build metadata remains absent.

candidate_sources.name: Autodesk AutoCAD sample files
candidate_sources.evidence: Autodesk says the current sample set applies to AutoCAD 2010 and later. A contemporaneous June 2009 index calls the files AutoCAD 2010 sample files and lists candidate DWGs including lineweights.dwg and visualization examples.
candidate_sources.limitation: Neither page identifies the producing AutoCAD executable/build or confirms that currently hosted bytes are original AutoCAD 2010 RTM saves. Ten downloaded AC1024 files were screened; none reproduces the failure.

candidate_sources.name: LibreDWG test-data/2010
candidate_sources.evidence: The public directory contains a broad set of 2010-labelled DWG samples (including Arc.dwg, Constraints.dwg, Line.dwg, Point.dwg, PolyLine3D.dwg, Spline.dwg and others) plus some paired DXFs.
candidate_sources.limitation: The directory label is a version/corpus label, not per-file AutoCAD 2010 RTM producer provenance. All 18 downloaded AC1024 files were screened; none reproduces the failure.

candidate_sources.name: nextgis/dwg_samples
candidate_sources.evidence: The README says the sample files were produced with trial AutoCAD 2016 M.49.0.0; its 2010-suffixed files use AC1024.
candidate_sources.limitation: The README identifies AutoCAD 2016 M.49.0.0 as producer. All previously screened AC1024 samples reach readDwgClasses END; this source does not qualify AutoCAD 2010 RTM behavior.

candidate_sources.name: monozukuri-ai/ezdwg example data
candidate_sources.evidence: The visible example directory contains AC1015/AC1018 samples (2000 and 2004 labels).
candidate_sources.limitation: No AC1024 candidate appears in the listed example directory.

next_action: The searched online corpora did not reproduce the reported failure. Keep the parser issue open and obtain the exact failing DWG/hash or a provenance-bearing AutoCAD 2010 RTM witness before changing the high-bit size path. Continue independent implementation work without waiting for that sample.
fixture_policy: Downloaded samples remain outside the repository; only files already in LibreCAD/libdxfrw repositories or authored locally from scratch may become committed fixtures.
